name: 28th Annual Global ISAM Congress (ISAM 2026)
description: The International Society of Addiction Medicine holds its 28th annual global congress in Rotterdam, Netherlands, from October 1 to 3, 2026, at the De Doelen venue. The program is organized around the theme of improving addiction treatment outcomes by addressing established and emerging challenges in the field.

deadlines.note: isamweb.org states only that submission opened in October 2025 without a specific day; day of month is an estimate.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: Stated on the official congress site as Tuesday, 31 March 2026, applying to symposium, workshop, oral presentation and poster submissions. isamweb.org/annual/ lists a conflicting close date of March 21, 2026 for the same deadline; the official congress site (isam2026rotterdam.org) is treated as authoritative since its stated weekday matches the calendar date.

name: Annual Global ISAM Congress 2027
description: The International Society of Addiction Medicine plans its next annual global congress in Seattle, United States, from August 26 to 28, 2027. Related events listed on the same schedule include an Innovation Day and a Women and Addiction Day on August 25, 2027, and a board meeting on August 24, 2027.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: No 2027 submission deadline has been published as of the access date. This date projects the 2026 cycle's interval (abstract deadline fell approximately six months before the congress start) onto the 2027 congress date and should be treated as a rough placeholder only.

sources.note: Only source found with 2027 Seattle congress dates (Aug 26 to 28, 2027, plus satellite Innovation Day, Women and Addiction Day, and Board meeting dates); no dedicated 2027 congress website exists yet and no submission or registration deadlines are listed.

notes: Event dates and city are published on the parent isamweb.org site but there is not yet a dedicated ISAM 2027 congress website (unlike the 2026 edition, which has isam2026rotterdam.org). Venue is not yet announced, so lat/lon use the Seattle city center. All deadline information is an estimate pending an official call for abstracts; maintainer should watch isamweb.org/annual/ for a dedicated 2027 site and real deadlines, expected to be announced roughly a year in advance based on the 2026 pattern.
